upstreamLicenseEvidence.statement: All data within the OpenFarm.cc database is in the Public Domain (CC0).

scope: Crop data only. No software, media, user accounts or gardens. Each recovered record retains its archive URL and capture date.
quality: Community-edited, historically recovered data; horticultural verification pending. Not an identification, edibility, medical or safety reference. Companion claims are retained only in the source snapshot and are not recommendation rules.
transformations: Stable source-specific identities; no automatic crop/cultivar joins.
Placeholder values become null; invalid or nonpositive dimensions are not promoted.
Plant spacing is not inferred from row spacing or spread.
No live API is needed during build.
